definition: The force per unit area, acting at right angles to a surface, $p = \frac{F}{A}$; measured in pascals ($1\ \text{Pa} = 1\ \text{N/m}^2$), and bigger for a bigger force on the same area or the same force on a smaller area.

The pressure caused by the weight of a liquid at a point below its surface; in a liquid at rest it increases with depth and with the density of the liquid, whatever the shape of the container (Extended: $\Delta p = \rho g \Delta h$).
